id: 07_Professionalism and Waste Disposal Key Practices for a Safer Laboratory
title: 职业素养与废物处置
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/07_Professionalism and Waste Disposal Key Practices for a Safer Laboratory.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/07_Professionalism and Waste Disposal Key Practices for a Safer Laboratory/src.py

points.K1: 安全文化差，多因不专业
points.K3: 不恶作剧、不打闹、守规范
points.K8: 能不能排，查说明书和规定
points.K9: 全流程靠素养、条理和沟通
points.S2: 收集容器管好，交学校处置
points.S3: 锐器和生物废物分开放

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排贴着空白标签的废液桶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a neat row of waste containers with blank labels in a lab corner and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲职业素养和废物处置。

shots.scene: 握手、护目镜、废液桶、对话气泡四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a handshake, safety goggles, a waste container and a speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 守规矩、戴防护、分好类、多沟通。

shots.scene: 阿杰端着一烧杯用过的溶液走向水槽
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in goggles and gloves carries a beaker of used solution toward a lab sink.
shots.narration: 实验做完，阿杰端着废液走向水槽。

shots.scene: 小研快步上前挡在水槽前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps in front of the sink and raises her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：废液不能倒下水道！

shots.scene: 小研指向角落的废液收集桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to the labeled waste containers in the lab corner.
shots.narration: 那边有分类的废液桶。

shots.section_title: 安全文化差，多因不专业
shots.scene: 欣欣站在杂乱的实验台旁皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot frowns beside a messy lab bench with scattered bottles and an open snack bag.
shots.narration: 安全文化差的实验室，常见问题是不专业。
overlay: 安全文化差，多因不专业

shots.scene: 实验室成员围在一起，每人头上一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Lab members including the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand together, each with a small shield icon above.
shots.narration: 安全文化要靠每个人一起建。

shots.scene: 小研动手前认真核对步骤
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully checks a blank procedure sheet before starting work.
shots.narration: 人人负责，凡事谨慎。

shots.section_title: 不恶作剧、不打闹、守规范
shots.scene: 两人在实验室追逐打闹的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two people chasing and playing pranks in a lab, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不搞恶作剧，不打闹嬉戏。
overlay: 不恶作剧、不打闹、守规范

shots.section_title: 不恶作剧、不打闹、守规范
shots.scene: 如实记录的实验记录本打勾
shots.prompt_en: An open lab notebook with neat entries and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 做事守规范，数据如实记录。

shots.scene: 阿杰把额头上的护目镜拉下来戴好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls his safety goggles down from his forehead to properly cover his eyes.
shots.narration: 护目镜要戴在眼睛上，不是额头上。

shots.scene: 手套、口罩、呼吸器、面屏四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: protective gloves, a face mask, a half-face respirator and a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 合适的手套，需要时戴口罩和面屏。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，旁边是没戴防护的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head beside a pictogram of a person without goggles or gloves, crossed out.
shots.narration: 防护不戴、不合适、戴不对，

shots.scene: 空白评分表上打了低分图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank evaluation sheet with a thumbs-down icon. No people.
shots.narration: 最能看出一个人不专业。

shots.scene: 水槽下水口，倒液体的烧杯被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab sink drain with a beaker pouring liquid into it, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 废物处置：别把废物倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 下水管连到河流，河里的鱼图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: A drain pipe icon leading to a river icon where a fish turns grey. No people.
shots.narration: 倒下去，会污染水体，还可能腐蚀管道。

shots.section_title: 能不能排，查说明书和规定
shots.scene: 小研查看空白说明书的废弃处置部分
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the disposal section of a blank safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 怎么处置，查说明书和本校规定。
overlay: 能不能排，查说明书和规定

shots.section_title: 能不能排，查说明书和规定
shots.scene: 危险废液桶打勾，下水道打叉
shots.prompt_en: A labeled hazardous waste container with a green check next to a sink drain crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险废液，一律收集，不倒下水道。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在几个不同颜色的废液桶前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of several waste containers in different colors with blank labels.
shots.narration: 废液要分类收集。

shots.scene: 两种废液倒在一起冒泡的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two different waste liquids mixed in one container and bubbling, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 相互会反应的，绝不能混在一桶。

shots.scene: 小研对照分类表把废液倒进对应的桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves pours waste into the matching container using a funnel, checking a blank chart.
shots.narration: 拿不准，先问再倒。

shots.section_title: 收集容器管好，交学校处置
shots.scene: 废液桶盖紧，贴着空白标签，放在托盘里
shots.prompt_en: A waste container with its cap tightly closed and a blank label, standing inside a spill tray. No people.
shots.narration: 桶要盖紧、贴签、放托盘。
overlay: 收集容器管好，交学校处置

shots.section_title: 收集容器管好，交学校处置
shots.scene: 废液桶液面在上方留出空间
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a waste container filled only partway, leaving headspace at the top, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不要装满，留出空间。

shots.section_title: 收集容器管好，交学校处置
shots.scene: 王老师和阿杰在空白交接单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the young male student sign a blank waste handover form beside waste containers.
shots.narration: 定期交学校统一处置，做好登记。

shots.section_title: 锐器和生物废物分开放
shots.scene: 锐器盒和碎玻璃盒
shots.prompt_en: A yellow sharps container and a separate box for broken glass on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 针头、刀片进锐器盒，碎玻璃单独放。
overlay: 锐器和生物废物分开放

shots.section_title: 锐器和生物废物分开放
shots.scene: 生物危害标志的废物袋和高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A waste bag with a biohazard sign next to an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物，按规定灭活后再处置。

shots.scene: 实验室里吃东西、喝水的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A no eating or drinking sign on a lab wall, with a snack and a cup crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃东西、不喝水。

shots.scene: 实验室冰箱里放着午饭，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab refrigerator with a lunch box inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室冰箱，不放食物。

shots.scene: 阿杰实验结束后擦净台面、关水关电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes the bench clean, turns off the water tap and switches off the power strip at the end of the day.
shots.narration: 做完收拾台面，关水关电再离开。

shots.section_title: 全流程靠素养、条理和沟通
shots.scene: 订购、使用、处置、消毒四个图标连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four icons connected in a loop: a shopping cart, a hand with a flask, a waste container and a spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 从采购、使用，到处置、消毒，
overlay: 全流程靠素养、条理和沟通

shots.section_title: 全流程靠素养、条理和沟通
shots.scene: 小研、阿杰、老周在实验室里交流
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the older man talk together in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 靠的是素养、条理和沟通。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现握手和护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a handshake and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 不打闹，守规范，防护戴到位。

shots.scene: 下水道打叉，分类废液桶打勾
shots.prompt_en: A sink drain crossed out next to sorted waste containers with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 废液不倒下水道，分类收集不混装。

shots.scene: 锐器盒、生物废物袋、交接单三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sharps container, a biohazard waste bag and a blank handover form. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器、生物废物分开，交学校处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验室里挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in a clean, tidy lab.
shots.narration: 专业做事，安全实验，下次见！
